scripts.build: npm run build:prover && npm run build:example && npm run build:wallet
scripts.typecheck: npm run types && npm run typecheck --workspace @heliuslabs/zolana-web-prover && npm run typecheck --workspace @zolana/browser-example && npm run typecheck --workspace @zolana/wallet-example
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @heliuslabs/zolana-web-prover && npm run test --workspace @zolana/browser-example && npm run test --workspace @zolana/wallet-example && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs packages/web-prover/scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @heliuslabs/zolana-web-prover
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:browser && npm run test:consumer
scripts.setup: npm run build:prover && npm run keys --workspace @zolana/browser-example
